description: This Java class configures SSL credentials for a web server in the Thingsboard project, customizing SSL settings and bundle management based on application properties.

classes.name: SslCredentialsWebServerCustomizer
classes.description: A Spring component that customizes the web server's SSL configuration based on application properties and SSL bundles.

methods.name: httpServerSslCredentials
methods.description: Creates and configures SSL credentials bean with prefix 'server.ssl.credentials'.

methods.name: customize
methods.description: Overrides the method to set SSL configuration on the web server factory.

methods.name: sslBundles
methods.description: Defines SSL bundle management, creating a default SSL bundle with the specified keystore and password.
